resolutions.researcher_notes: OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2013, Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2012' lists an existing 'Juaymah/Jubail' Saudi Aramco line, corroborating that it was an in-service (operating) gas pipeline as of the 2012 inventory. 'operating' is inferred from inclusion in the operational pipeline inventory, not a literal token. Original opec.org flipbook page 403s to bots (bot-wall); citing the verified Wayback snapshot (HTTP 200, contains Juaymah/Jubail/Saudi Aramco). Single-publisher source -> medium.

OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 lists Juaymah/Jubail explicitly within the 'Gas pipelines' table, confirming Fuel = Gas. Offshore Technology (Saudi Aramco projects) independently describes the Ju'aymah gas fractionation plant near Ras Tanura producing ethane/NGL (gas-derived), corroborating the gas nature of the Juaymah system. Two independent origins -> high.

OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 lists 'Juaymah/Jubail  Saudi Aramco  35 [miles]  30/38/40 [inches]' - exact match to the GEM value Diameter = 38,30,40 in (35 miles = 56 km, matching the recorded length). This specific multi-diameter value appears only in the OPEC bulletin; no independent second source found carrying the 30/38/40 spec -> medium (single-publisher).

FuelSource 'Al Juaima'h' = Ju'aymah (transliteration variant). OPEC ASB2013 lists Juaymah as the origin of the Juaymah/Jubail line. Offshore Technology independently confirms the Ju'aymah gas fractionation plant near Ras Tanura, Eastern Province, as the Saudi Aramco NGL/ethane source feeding Jubail petrochemicals. Two independent origins -> high.

OPEC ASB2013 lists the line as 'Juaymah/Jubail' under Saudi Arabia, giving both endpoints; both Juaymah (Ras Tanura area) and Al Jubail sit in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. Offshore Technology independently places Ju'aymah near Ras Tanura, Eastern Province. Start = Eastern Province / Saudi Arabia and End = Al Jubail / Eastern Province / Saudi Arabia both supported. Note: the explicit Jubail endpoint rests on the OPEC listing; offshore-technology corroborates the Juaymah end + Eastern Province. Two independent origins -> high.

OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 names 'Saudi Aramco' as owner/operator of the Juaymah/Jubail line. Offshore Technology independently attributes the Ju'aymah gas fractionation / NGL system to Saudi Aramco. Owner1 = Saudi Aramco 100% supported by two independent origins -> high.
